implementation: Bounded original token grammars informed by the referenced corpora; not complete CRS/Sigma parity.

sources.use: Quoted SQL keyword and UNION SELECT grammar; bounded simplified adaptation.
930100/930110 traversal and 930120 OS-file concepts; paths reaching above root plus a small sensitive-path set.
931110 vulnerable-parameter + remote scheme and 931120 remote script URL concepts; ordinary redirect URLs excluded.
Shell control token followed by a bounded command vocabulary; no obfuscation-complete shell parser.
Template delimiters plus arithmetic, dunder access or dangerous object access; ordinary variable interpolation excluded.

limitations: Encrypted HTTP and absent body content cannot be judged.
At most two percent-decoding passes; strict UTF-8 rejects overlong encodings.
Session URI lists do not prove transaction counts or association with status or user-agent.
Every class remains lead; 2xx does not establish exploitation.
Finite vocabularies do not cover every attack or tool.
